To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
temporally unpredictable sounds exert a context-dependent influence on the evaluation of unrelated neutral pictures, and on the evaluation of face photographs.
temporally unpredictable sounds influence the evaluation of unrelated neutral images as more negative, and unrelated angry or fearful images as more fearful.
unpredictable sounds influence evaluation of unrelated images, but not when the images and sounds are presented together.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how unpredictable stimuli influence behaviour and affective evaluation of unrelated stimuli.
how temporally unpredictable sound sequences influence the evaluation of visual stimuli, and how this relates to previous findings of the influence of temporally unpredictable sounds on behaviour.
the influence of temporally unpredictable sounds on the processing of visual stimuli.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

unpredictable sounds exert context-dependent influences on evaluation of unrelated stimuli, and that these effects are mediated by the unpredictable sound sequences, rather than by the unpredictability per se.
temporally unpredictable sound sequences are not intrinsically aversive or anxiety-inducing, but that they exert a context-dependent influence on the evaluation of other stimuli.
temporally unpredictable sounds exert a context dependent influence on evaluation of unrelated images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
unpredictability of sound sequences can be evaluated as negative, and that it may interact with evaluation of other stimuli.

unpredictability is a context-dependent factor that can influence behaviour, but that it does so by influencing the evaluation of the context rather than by influencing the evaluation or experience of the unpredictable stimuli themselves.
unpredictability of sounds influences the evaluation of unrelated visual stimuli, and that this influence is context-dependent, as it depends on the valence of the visual context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the influence of unpredictable sounds on behaviour is not a general response to unpredictable stimuli per se, but depends on the context of the task.
unpredictable sounds can influence human affective evaluation in a task-dependent way.
unpredictable sounds exert context-dependent influences on the evaluation of unrelated visual stimuli.
